Name: Gem's Neutral-Toned Rugs (AT)
Author: gemsthetic
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/J8iZG0j.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿[/center][center]A small pack of 8 new rugs available via AT!



﻿[color=#cfe2f3][img]https://fontmeme.com/permalink/240825/bc572c8d4f964cfb2409f1d43b59581d.png[/img][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4]Install manually, or with your preferred mod manager. Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿.
Uninstalling should be safe; just change the texture of the rugs you've placed before uninstalling to avoid any issues.
[/color]

[img]https://fontmeme.com/permalink/250318/459f1a0893544f96aba784633eec13cb.png[/img]

Obtain the paint bucket tool from Robin's shop after installing Alternative Textures, or use the furniture catalog. The new textures are found via using the paint bucket/furniture catalog on the 'Red Rug' furniture item.
﻿
[color=#f4f4f4][img]https://fontmeme.com/permalink/240825/66d10bca0cca8dd8d46466a9efb18383.png[/img][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4]Should be compatible with everything. Not tested on pre-1.6 SDV versions.[/color]


[color=#f4f4f4][img]https://fontmeme.com/permalink/240825/8818b500764d0c577bd1b554ed09a80b.png[/img][/color]
